d:
This emotional storytelling track delves into the artist's personal struggles, shedding light on the challenges faced in their journey. Drawing inspiration from the classic "Dheere Dheere Bol Koi Sun Na Le", the track uses its gentle cadence to emphasize the importance of patience and perseverance.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Dheere Dheere Bol Koi Sun Na Le -The Hustle Flip
Written & Performed By: Lashcurry
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Lashcurry
Track Name: Dheere Dheere Bol Koi Sun Na Le -The Hustle Flip
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Lashcurry
